name: Night train
about: A dining car on a night express. Hills go by in the windows, your job is a ticket that gets punched, the radio car plays.

words.note: Leave a note for the conductor.

gags: A man two seats down has been reading the same page since Vienna. He says he's spacing it out.
punches a ticket with great ceremony. It's the only thing he's sure of tonight.
Someone wrote in the fogged window: retrieval > rereading. It's still there an hour later.
The radio car only gets one station after midnight. Nobody has asked to change it.
The passenger across the aisle is studying flashcards upside down. Says it's harder that way. Says that's the point.
announces the next stop. It's the same as the last one. It's always tonight.
A sign by the door: no cramming between stations.

lines.play: A play block. The passenger across the aisle puts away his book too. Fun is on the timetable.
lines.evening: Evening. The train fills up around now. Nobody else in this car brought homework.
lines.friday: Friday night, and you're on a night train studying. The other passengers respect it. Quietly.
lines.silent: Nothing graded in {days} days. The conductor is just watching the hills.
lines.newyear: New year. Same train. The ticket book doesn't reset.
lines.nye: Last night of the year. Fill the ticket book, not just the year.
lines.halloween: Halloween. Someone in the sleeper car is dressed as a ghost train. Very committed.
lines.valentine: Valentine's Day. Two passengers share one textbook. It's either romance or a budget.
lines.music_quiet: The radio car is quiet. Press play, or listen to the rails.

lines.day: Another stretch done. The conductor punches your ticket.
lines.week: A week on the line. A postcard from the last station goes on your shelf.
lines.die: A ticket book, every stub punched. It's on the shelf.
lines.gift: The conductor left something at your seat. It's on the shelf.
